Castello Banfi

Banfi Centine Rosso

RedToscana IGTWine region Tuscany

Tuscan red from Castello Banfi made in Montalcino from Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, one of the house’s most affordable labels.

Centine is one of the most widely available lines from Castello Banfi, the large estate on the southern side of Montalcino. Unlike Brunello, which must be made solely from Sangiovese and aged for a long time, this wine is sold as Toscana IGT, which allows varieties to be blended and the wine to be released much sooner.

It is made from Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot from the estate’s vineyards; the proportions vary with the vintage. The varieties are vinified separately and the wine spends a short period in oak, enough to round it out without overshadowing the fruit.

It is a young, medium-bodied red in a fruity style, intended for everyday drinking. It offers a simple way into the wines of Montalcino, although its profile is very different from that of the house’s Brunellos.

Tasting profile

Purple-tinged ruby. Aromas of cherry, plum, red berries and a touch of vanilla. Smooth, fruity palate with gentle tannins.

Food pairing

Pizza, pasta with tomato, grilled meat, burgers, semi-aged cheeses

Serving

16-18 °C, large glass
